name: Unfallwerkbank
description: Open-source browser and server toolkit for exploring, filtering, visualising and exporting official German road accident open data. It supports interactive Leaflet maps, cluster and heatmap views, context-aware filtering, local political request drafts, PDF/Word exports, optional AI-assisted assessment, and an optional Spring Boot analysis service for persistent location action briefs and prioritisation.
runtimePlatform: Browser, Node.js, Docker, Java 21, Spring Boot
applicationCategory: Road Safety, Geospatial Analysis, Civic Technology, Open Data
softwareRequirements: Node.js 24+ for tests and optional Node server
Java 21+ for the optional analysis service
Optional AI provider configuration for AI-assisted assessments
